$comment: Every desktop-profile row of @rightkit/release ownership-mandatory-set.json, declared (Orthic-Labs/ember#240). `adopted` names the owner pins and where they are wired; `pending` covers the owner-pending rows (never enforced); `notApplicable` holds only the rulings ratified for Ember in Orthic-Labs/rightkit#280 (appAmendments.ember). M14 is adopted (@rightkit/legal 0.6.1 OSS profile), so its ruling is not claimed. The checker reads `profile` and `notApplicable`; `adopted` and `pending` are the record for people and agents.

adopted.M1: rightkit-tauri-shell =0.4.0 and rightkit-device =0.4.0 (apps/lightcraft-desktop/Cargo.toml; window host in src/native.rs, device id in src/rk_device.rs), @rightkit/tauri 0.2.3 and @rightkit/tauri-shell 0.1.1 (package.json; apps/lightcraft-desktop/web/src/rightkitTauri.ts). Kept window behaviour: docs/rightkit-exceptions/M1.md.
adopted.M5: rightkit-child-process =0.5.2: every owned child process (crates/engine, crates/av1dec/src/host.rs, apps/lightcraft-desktop/src/services.rs, apps/lightcraft).
adopted.M8: rightkit-fs =0.4.4: catalog journal and locks (crates/catalog), engine sidecars and exports (crates/engine), caches (crates/preview, crates/denoise-core), desktop preferences and backups (apps/lightcraft-desktop, crates/desktop-host), CLI outputs. Kept file behaviour: docs/rightkit-exceptions/M8.md.
adopted.M11: rightkit-credentials =0.4.2: the per-install device id lives in the OS credential store through rightkit-device's CredentialStore (apps/lightcraft-desktop/src/rk_device.rs). Ember stores no other secret.
adopted.M16: rightkit-crash =0.3.3: panic hook and catch_unwind guard around command dispatch and import/export (crates/engine/src/guard.rs).
adopted.M18: @rightkit/app-update 0.4.2 (apps/lightcraft-desktop/web/src/updates.ts) over tauri-plugin-updater =2.14.0; GitHub Releases lane with the suite updater key (right-release.config.mjs distribution).
adopted.M19: @rightkit/release 0.6.4 (devDependency): right-release.config.mjs, .rightkit-local-build.json, switches.json, and the committed .githooks/pre-push written by `rightkit-gate install-hook`.
adopted.M20: rightkit-qa =0.7.0: the qa-native control host (apps/lightcraft-desktop/src/native.rs, rightkit_qa::embedded::Control) and the native qualification tests; @rightkit/qa 0.5.1 and @rightkit/qa-chrome 0.1.8 are declared devDependencies, pinned by scripts/desktop/static-check.mjs (no JS lane imports them yet).

pending.M21: Owner not selected (D4 unratified). Test mode today: the qa-native feature and RIGHTKIT_QA_* reads in apps/lightcraft-desktop/src/native.rs; switches.json inventories them. rightkit-daemon arrives only transitively (rightkit-tauri-shell, rightkit-qa); Ember runs no daemon (M6/M7 n/a).
pending.M23: Owner not selected (D4 unratified). @rightkit/release 0.6.4 is adopted; switches.json is the release-switch inventory the release scan checks.
pending.M25: Journeys capability not published in rightkit-qa / @rightkit/qa; Ember's native journeys run through rightkit-qa 0.7.0 today (Orthic-Labs/ember#249).

notApplicable.M3: No supervised engine child and no restart-surviving jobs: exports and imports are in-process jobs on the activity stack; every owned child process goes through rightkit-child-process (M5). The ffmpeg sidecar already runs through rightkit-ffmpeg.
notApplicable.M4: No supervised engine child and no restart-surviving jobs: the command registry is served in-process; exports and imports are in-process jobs on the activity stack.
notApplicable.M6: No local service or daemon-discovered data location. The control channel and MCP are opt-in developer and agent ports.
notApplicable.M7: No local service or daemon-discovered data location. The control channel and MCP are opt-in developer and agent ports.
notApplicable.M9: No SQLite app state. Preferences are JSON through rightkit-app-settings; the photo catalog is a JSON-lines journal.
notApplicable.M12: Free and open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0): no paid features, activation or signer. rightkit-device identity is adopted. Applies to OSS apps.
notApplicable.M13: Free and open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0): no paid features, activation or signer. Applies to OSS apps.
notApplicable.M22: rightkit-agent-tools needs a daemon-backed app control service. Ember's agent surface is its own MCP server over engine command ids, being ported to rightkit-mcp. Applies to non-daemon apps.
